events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins sure earned all that money Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins throws for 509 yards, hits Hodge in OT to give Falcons 36-30 win over Bucs

events.name: New York Jets at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers had a message for Andrew Van Ginkel after the Vikings linebacker returned an interception 63 yards for a touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings hold off Rodgers and the Jets for 23-17 win in London to improve to 5-0

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams found DJ Moore wide open on a crossing pattern early in the game for a 34-yard touchdown. From there, just about everything else looked easy, too.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams and DJ Moore lead the way in Bears' 36-10 rout of Panthers

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson and Joe Burrow traded touchdown throws all afternoon. It took a big run and a chip-shot kick in overtime to settle a wild game between the Baltimore Ravens and Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Tucker's field goal after Derrick Henry's big run lifts Ravens to a wild 41-38 overtime win

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — The Miami Dolphins made just enough plays to beat the New England Patriots and enough mistakes to lose to just about anyone else.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Dolphins made so many mistakes against New England. The Patriots made more in Miami's 15-10 win

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels shook off throwing an early interception at the goal line like it was his 50th NFL game, not his fifth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels and the Commanders rout the Browns 34-13 to win their 4th in a row

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — No longer winless, the Jacksonville Jaguars can now start working on not being defenseless.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lawrence comes up big on his birthday and leads the Jags to their 1st win, 37-34 over the Colts

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — All week, Stefon Diggs downplayed how big it would be when he faced the Buffalo Bills for the first time since a blockbuster trade brought him to Houston.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fairbairn's 59-yard field goal as time expires gives Texans 23-20 win over Bills

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — When Pat Surtain II was about to sign his colossal contract extention that briefly made him the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history,...
headlines.shortLinkText: Surtain's two interceptions power Broncos past Raiders 34-18, snapping 8-game skid against Las Vegas

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Kyler Murray's day started with a 50-yard touchdown run where he pointed to the end zone in celebration almost as soon as he crossed the line of scrimmage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyler Murray rallies the Cardinals past the 49ers, 24-23

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Green Bay's Jordan Love could have wallowed in self doubt after throwing the first pick-6 of his career during the second quarter against the Los Angeles Rams. Instead, it ended up motivating the quarterback and his Packers teammates.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love throws a pair of TD passes in the second half to rally Packers past Rams 24-19

events.name: New York Giants at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Isaiah Simmons was added to the field goal block team for the New York Giants this week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants use strong performance from Daniel Jones and late TD on blocked kick to beat Seahawks 29-20

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott drifted to his left, then drifted some more. On a seemingly endless night, what was another couple of seconds going to hurt?
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws TD pass to Tolbert with 20 seconds left to lift Cowboys past Steelers, 20-17

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes threw for a bunch of yards. Travis Kelce caught a whole lot of his passes. And Kareem Hunt plowed into the end zone once again, sending a torrent of red fireworks flying over Arrowhead Stadium on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes throws for 331 yards, Derek Carr hurt as Chiefs shut down Saints for 26-13 victory

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Deebo Samuel didn't hesitate when he was asked what was working for the San Francisco 49ers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy throws for 3 TDs and the 49ers beat the Seahawks 36-24 to move atop division

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Chicago Bears tight end Cole Kmet faced his biggest fear in football with no notice.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williams throws 4 TDs and TE Kmet handles long snaps for Bears in 35-16 rout of Jaguars in London

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Romeo Doubs wanted to make amends after serving a one-game suspension for what the Green Bay Packers described as conduct detrimental to the team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doubs catches 2 TD passes in his return from a suspension to help Packers rout Cardinals 34-13

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Joe Flacco has been around the NFL long enough to know the backup quarterback should always be ready to start.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Flacco throws two TD passes as the battered Colts beat the Titans 20-17

events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud threw three touchdown passes and the Houston Texans spoiled the first start of rookie New England quarterback Drake Maye, breezing past the Patriots 41-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud throws 3 TD passes as the Texans beat the Patriots 41-21 in Drake Maye's first start

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — To Baker Mayfield, the way the Tampa Bay Buccaneers weathered a wild second quarter in which they lost a 17-point lead was symbolic of their mindset ever since they traveled to New Orleans on Tuesday to escape the path of Hurricane Milton.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield passes for 4 TDs as the Bucs treat storm-weary fans to a 51-27 win over the Saints

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Perhaps indignant that Eagles fans had chanted for his firing, Nick Sirianni could not button up his mouth in the final seconds. Philadelphia's coach — already a habitual trash-talking offender — put a finger to his right ear and chirped at fans in...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts throws 2 TD passes as the Eagles hold off the Browns 20-16

events.name: Washington Commanders at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson threw nine passes to Zay Flowers in the first half and never went to him again. Mark Andrews rebounded from a ball bouncing off his hands for an interception to catch his first touchdown pass of the season. And Derrick Henry was...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson outduels Daniels and Henry runs for two TDs as Ravens beat Commanders 30-23

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Justin Herbert and the Los Angeles Chargers had to concern themselves with Patrick Surtain II for only a single snap Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herbert leads Chargers to 23-16 win over the Broncos, who lose Surtain to a concussion

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Najee Harris broke free down the left sideline, reached the 5-yard line and dived toward the pylon, just getting the ball across the goal line for a Steelers touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Najee Harris' first 100-yard rushing game this season lifts Steelers to 32-13 win over Raiders

events.name: Detroit Lions at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Jared Goff's completion streak ended on his first throw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 3 TD passes, Lions win 47-9 and hand Cowboys another lopsided home loss

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The Atlanta Falcons are proving they have multiple ways to win — especially against a division foe.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bijan Robinson scores 2 TDs. Falcons beat Panthers 38-20 for 3rd straight victory vs. NFC South foe

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow made just enough plays and the maligned Bengals defense stepped up and delivered a much-needed victory that gave Cincinnati some hope after a dismal start.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow runs for a TD and the Bengals' defense carries them past the Giants, 17-7

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills were expecting to go into halftime against the New York Jets with a 10-point lead and all the momentum.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen and Bills overcome Rodgers' Hail Mary and beat Jets 23-20 to take control in AFC East

events.name: Denver Broncos at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Sean Payton made a point of getting to the Superdome long before he normally would for a game — six hours before kickoff — so he could ease into his emotional return to a place where he coached on the home sideline for a decade and a half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Payton triumphs in return to New Orleans as the Broncos dominate the Saints, 33-10

events.name: New England Patriots at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — The Jacksonville Jaguars didn't show any quit this week after falling behind early on Sunday against the New England Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bigsby scores 2 TDs as Jaguars show fight in 32-16 win over Patriots in London

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks had something to prove on defense after three dismal performances.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith throws 2 TD passes, Seahawks defense dominates in a 34-14 win over the Falcons

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — It didn’t take Amari Cooper long to get the hang of Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills' offense — even when the quarterback was changing plays at the line of scrimmage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper scores in his Bills debut and Allen shakes off a sluggish start in 34-10 rout of Titans

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — As Deshaun Watson tucked the ball under his arm and collapsed without being touched, some Browns fans cheered.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns lose QB Deshaun Watson to Achilles tendon injury as they fall 21-14 to the Bengals

events.name: Houston Texans at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Brandon McManus insisted he hadn't planned to do a “Lambeau leap” if he made a winning field goal in his Green Bay Packers debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon McManus' field goal on the final play gives Packers a 24-22 victory over Texans

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Anthony Richardson didn’t even bother to look at the stats on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: QB Richardson's late scoring drives send Colts past Dolphins 16-10

events.name: Detroit Lions at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions became division champions for the first time in 30 years late last season with a clinching win at Minnesota. They departed this...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions top previously unbeaten Vikings 31-29 on late FG to cap NFC North thriller

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Coming into MetLife Stadium to face the New York Giants for the first time as a member of the Philadelphia Eagles, Saquon Barkley said he saw fans burning his old Giants jersey.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barkley rushes for 176 yards and a TD in a memorable return as the Eagles blitz the Giants 28-3

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Rams' defense hasn't been good in its first season after Aaron Donald's retirement. Forcing turnovers has been a particular area of struggle.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams force 4 turnovers and hold off Raiders 20-15 after QB Aidan O'Connell gets injured

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels' health was the first thing on Marcus Mariota's mind when he went into the game for the injured rookie quarterback. Then he...
headlines.shortLinkText: Commanders lose Jayden Daniels to a rib injury in a 40-7 romp over the Panthers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Francisco 49ers
New York Jets at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Russell Wilson sat at the podium, uniform still on, in no rush to move on from a moment he believed would always come.
headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson throws for 2 TDs, runs for another TD in Pittsburgh debut as Steelers rout Jets 37-15

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson, who may be playing the best football of his career, made it look easy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson throws for 281 yards, 5 TDs to lead streaking Ravens to 41-31 victory over Buccaneers

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Arizona's Kyler Murray rolled out to his left before turning on the jets, beating a Chargers defender to the sideline and then coasting for a spectacular 44-yard touchdown,...
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray runs for a TD, leads Cardinals to game-winning FG and 17-15 win over Chargers

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Cooper Kupp and Puka Nacua have missed most of the season due to injury, and the Los Angeles Rams' dismal record reflected it.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Kupp and Nacua back from injury, Stafford throws 4 TD passes in Rams' 30-20 win over Vikings

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts and Saquon Barkley led Philadelphia to another impressive performance on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts and Saquon Barkley help the Eagles run away from the Bengals for a 37-17 win

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — During an impassioned pregame speech, Jameis Winston asked his Browns teammates to believe.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws 3 TD passes as Browns stun Jackson, Ravens 29-24 to end 5-game losing streak

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff threw three touchdown passes but was far from the star for the Detroit Lions in one of the highest-scoring games in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws for 3 TDs and Lions win 5th straight, dominating Titans 52-14

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Kyler Murray never lost confidence. Even with the Arizona Cardinals down by two scores in the fourth quarter, he knew he was capable of making the plays his team needed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyler Murray rallies Cardinals to 28-27 win over Dolphins in Tua Tagovailoa's return

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Inches from the goal line with one last chance to punch in the game-winning score, the New England Patriots proved to be tough enough to beat Aaron Rodgers and the stumbling New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Maye out, 'soft' Patriots come back to send Rodgers and Jets to 5th straight loss

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Atlanta is still working on not being the same old Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins throws for 276 yards and 4 TDs as Falcons beat Bucs 31-26 to take control of NFC South

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — The Green Bay Packers might have to play without quarterback Jordan Love again.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Love watching from the sideline, the Packers beat the Jaguars 30-27 for 4th straight win

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Joe Mixon evaded one defender and dragged a defensive back into the end zone with him on a 14-yard touchdown run in the highlight of yet another big game to help the Houston Texans beat the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud throws TD pass, Mixon adds score as Texans outlast Colts 23-20

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Ladd McConkey was a downfield threat while helping lead the University of Georgia to a pair of College Football Playoff championships.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ladd McConkey's 2 touchdowns propel Chargers to 26-8 victory over Saints

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Josh Allen threw two touchdown passes and the surging Buffalo Bills turned his first interception of the season into an afterthought, pummeling the Seattle Seahawks 31-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws 2 TD passes and the Bills cruise past the Seahawks 31-10

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Sean Payton didn't like the way the Denver Broncos started or finished their 28-14 win over the injury-riddled Carolina Panthers. In between, there was plenty for him to enjoy, though.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Bo Nix has 3 TD passes in leading the Broncos to a 28-14 win over the Panthers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes didn't make many mistakes Sunday, but one of his few errors could've cost the Chiefs the game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes passes for 262 yards and 2 TDs, Chiefs beat Raiders 27-20 to improve to 7-0

events.name: Chicago Bears at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels had a couple of very simple thoughts going through his head with the Washington Commanders needing to make a long-distance throw to beat the Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels' Hail Mary TD to Noah Brown gives Commanders 18-15 win over Bears

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — One dominant quarter against Dallas proved to be enough for the San Francisco 49ers to head into their bye week on a high note.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy helps the 49ers bounce back with a 30-24 victory over the Cowboys

events.name: New York Giants at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin pulled Calvin Austin III aside before the undersized wide receiver took the field for a punt return in the third quarter of a somewhat lifeless game against the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Calvin Austin III scores twice as the Steelers hold off the Giants 26-18

events.name: Houston Texans at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Move over Odell Beckham Jr., Garrett Wilson might have snatched your spot among the NFL's greatest catches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garrett Wilson makes eye-popping TD catch, Jets beat Texans 21-13 to snap 5-game skid
